The '''Vaced system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]].
